Decides which list the task is on.
Personal: a free tag shown on the task. Work: the project name; matched to an existing Work project ignoring letter case, otherwise kept as typed.

accepted_values: Any real calendar date; past dates allowed (shows as overdue)
format: YYYY-MM-DD preferred (2026-11-24). DD/MM/YYYY also accepted (24/11/2026), day first. NOT accepted: 11/24/2026, 24/11/26, 2026-1-5, words like "tomorrow".
if_left_blank: No date (but today if repeat, remind_time or must_today is set)
notes: Excel often rewrites dates when saving; both formats above survive that. Impossible dates such as 31/04/2026 are rejected.

format: HH:MM, 24-hour clock (09:30, 14:00). 9:05 also accepted. NOT accepted: 9am, 0930, 24:00.
notes: If Apple Calendar is connected the task appears there with an alert. With no due_date the task is dated today.

accepted_values: daily | weekdays | weekly | fortnightly | monthly | yearly (any letter case)

notes: Work-list priority: 0 none, 1 = !, 2 = !!, 3 = !!! (most important). NOT accepted: 4, -1, high, 1.5.

accepted_values: yes | no | y | n | true | false | 1 | 0 (any letter case)
notes: Marks a quick task (Work list ordering).

notes: If yes, due_date must be blank, today or earlier (blank becomes today). A later date is rejected.

format: Plain text. Line breaks are kept; wrap the cell in double quotes if it has commas or line breaks.
example: "Ask about the October invoice, then book"
notes: Shown in the task detail sheet.

format: CSV saved as UTF-8 (Excel: Save As > CSV UTF-8). First row = header with the column names above, any order, any letter case (spaces or hyphens count as underscores). Comma separated (semicolon also read). Max 1000 tasks per file.
notes: Unknown columns are ignored and listed. If any row is invalid NOTHING is added and the page lists each line number and reason. Importing the same file twice adds every task twice.
